# DSH Desktop Mint __VERSION__

This is a **code-signed and notarized** release of the unofficial DSH Desktop distribution maintained by Mint. It is built on DeepSeek Harness and is not endorsed, cooperated with, or authorized by DeepSeek.

## Release information

- Desktop version: `__VERSION__`
- Embedded DeepSeek Harness: `__UPSTREAM_REF__` at `__UPSTREAM_COMMIT__`
- Desktop source commit: `__SOURCE_COMMIT__`
- Upstream changes: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/__UPSTREAM_REF__

## Update assets

The release contains notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, signed update ZIPs and blockmaps, the combined `latest-mac.yml` update feed, and `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Installed stable clients can discover this release and let the user choose when to download and install it.

---

## 发布信息

- Desktop 版本：`__VERSION__`
- 内置 DeepSeek Harness：`__UPSTREAM_REF__`，提交 `__UPSTREAM_COMMIT__`
- Desktop 源码提交：`__SOURCE_COMMIT__`
- 上游变更：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/__UPSTREAM_REF__

## 更新产物

本 Release 包含适用于 Apple Silicon 和 Intel Mac 的已公证 DMG、签名更新 ZIP 与 blockmap、合并后的 `latest-mac.yml` 更新源和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。已安装的稳定版客户端会发现此版本，并由用户决定何时下载和安装。
